name: a 2 b Man And Van
description: Expert man and van removals offering seamless, hassle-free transportation, logistics, and rubbish clearance. Choose us & Call Today On!

mainEntity.name: are there any hidden or extra charges?

acceptedAnswer.text: no. as long as we're given clear honest information in regards to the move/ removal/ clearance and the job itself, everything will be included in the final quote

mainEntity.name: how are we any different from any other removals business?

acceptedAnswer.text: every bought goods online or in-store but decided not to pay extortionate delivery fees or needed it immediately, perhaps you need to make a market run at 2am for your shop/business., we do it all, get in touch

mainEntity.name: how long will my move take?

acceptedAnswer.text: ideally we'd will look to have you moved within the same day but exactly how long will depend on the size of the property, access to and from, distance to new move, traffic and whether is packing is required

mainEntity.name: how would my belongings including valuable and/or fragile be protected?

acceptedAnswer.text: with a mix of furniture covers, large items will be carefully dissambled if needed, padding in the form of bubble wrap & rigifoam along with everything being secured by tie down straps and balanced weighting

mainEntity.name: what is your cancellation and rescheduling policy?

acceptedAnswer.text: while our quotations are free of charge, if you do decide to move with us we do take a 25% deposit which will be non refundable on cancellation. Rescheduling will need to be done in advance minimum (3 hours) allowing us time to rebook you in at no extra cost
